head: Untitled Starry Sky AI art app turns sketches and photos into art
dek: Untitled Starry Sky is a free iPhone and iPad app that turns a written idea, a photo or a few drawn strokes into a collage, geometric or abstract painting with AI. It was #60 among free Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 21 November.
details: You can draw with brushes, pencils and markers (Apple Pencil works) and pick how freely the AI reworks your sketch; 36 starter prompts cover scenery, pets, portraits, objects, feelings and fantasy. Drafts and finished works stay on the device, and you can add a frame colour, title and signature before saving as PNG or JPEG. The listing shows no in-app purchases and says no data is collected. It's from developer Samuel Richard Quincy, out since 5 November, with no ratings yet.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad, free
means: If you doodle on your phone, this turns rough sketches into finished-looking pictures you can frame and share.
todo: Search Untitled Starry Sky on the App Store; it's new and has no reviews yet, so try it with a sketch or one of the built-in prompts first.
